prompt: Summarise the history of the world in 10, 20, 50, and 100 words
response:
10 words: Humans evolved, civilizations rose and fell, empires expanded and contracted, leading to today's world.
20 words: Early humans developed tools and agriculture, leading to settled societies. Empires like Rome and China shaped cultures. Modern nation-states emerged post-colonialism.
50 words: Homo sapiens evolved in Africa, developing language and tools. Agricultural revolution led to settled societies and early empires. Religions and philosophies spread. Colonialism reshaped the globe, leading to the modern nation-state system.
100 words: Homo sapiens evolved in Africa, developing language and tools. Agricultural revolution led to settled societies and early empires like Egypt and Mesopotamia. Religions and philosophies spread, shaping cultures. Colonialism reshaped the globe, leading to the modern nation-state system and globalization.
